realtimeRenderingDescription: Update edits and layout changes immediately. Turn this off to use Typora's rendering delay for documents with many or complex diagrams.
variablesDescription: Enter --pele-* variable declarations, one per line, without a .pele selector. Changes are saved and applied automatically. Leave empty to use the default colors.
unsupportedRenderer: Pele cannot replace this Typora mermaidAPI property.
